[[Ironclaw]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] dropped by [[Chkkr Ironclaw]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Mourning Veil Falls]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15%
:[[Energy]] -5
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Gothic Axe]].

==Replica==

*[[Cleaver]] from crafters [[Gertrud]] or [[Telamon]]

*[[Perfect]] [[Axe Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR

**[[Winged Axe]] from crafters [[Shausha]], [[Hadusi]], [[Bolereh]], [[Tehshan]], [[Sende]], or [[Rahmdah]]
